biocs.name: Masqueraded Third-Party Utility Execution
biocs.description: Detection of legitimate utility (wmi.exe) being used to execute malicious code
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'wmi.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name != 'wmi.exe'

abiocs.name: Suspicious Masquerade Behavior
abiocs.description: Detection of process execution where a legitimate utility is used to launch an unexpected child process
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'wmi.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name != 'wmi.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'cmd.exe'

xql_queries.name: Masquerade Process Start Detection
